title: EF Core: Loading Data & N+1 Problem

scenes.line1: How does loading strategy impact performance?
scenes.say: How does your data loading strategy affect performance in Entity Framework Core? Can you avoid the N plus one query problem?

scenes.label: Eager
scenes.sub: Fetch related data up front with Include.
scenes.say: Eager loading grabs related data right away using the Include method.

right.title: Explicit
items: Loads data when you call Load()

scenes.say: Lazy loading fetches related data only when you access it, which can trigger lots of queries. Explicit loading gives you control—you call Load when you need the data.
Eager loading with Include avoids the N plus one problem by fetching orders and their items in one query.

scenes.question: How does lazy loading cause N+1?
scenes.wrong: It loads all data in one query.
scenes.right: It runs one query for each related entity, causing performance issues.
scenes.say: Lazy loading can cause the N plus one problem by running one query for each related entity, hurting performance.
